claim: A door that rises (type 600) sounds like what its leaf is made of, as the campaign's ceiling doors wearing that tile do: a wooden leaf (22) starts on 110 or 160, panelled metal (495) starts on 111 and commonly stops on 165, stone (110, 1011) uses 106. Stone's 106 on a wooden door sounds like moving stone.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-23: 'These wooden zdoor sound 106 sounds like a moving stone ... example 110 would be better'
campaign ceiling doors by leaf tile, tabulated in projects/blood-city/level/motion_sounds.py (22: 110/160 leads four times, 106 never)
use: Choose a mover's start and stop sounds from the tile its neighbours see of it; a body of many sectors gets one voice.
